name: Port Perry–Whitby / Beaverton
description: Rural GO bus between Whitby GO, Port Perry and communities north to Beaverton. Timetables also show the short Port Perry–Whitby branch. Union times were connecting train times, not an 81 through bus.

timeline.event: The timetable documents Beaverton–Cannington–Sunderland–Port Perry–Whitby 81 and Port Perry–Whitby 81A.
GO added Beaverton weekday trips and provided three weekend trips in each direction.
The route continued in the original Port Perry timetable.
